# P36.61 — Queue hub, facet routes and cards (K11 RQ-03a)

Manifest row 404. Branch `r11/P36.61-queue-hub-facets-cards`, stacked on `r11/P36.60-evidence-hub-and-artifact-pages` (the operator retargets to `main`). `live_verification=false` — no `live:`-leg, no production mutation, no gate flips, no claim-spine write.

## What landed

The research queue becomes a traversable T1, zero-JS route family over the P36.58 `sig.queue-card/2` export:

| route | content |
|---|---|
| `/research-queue/` + `/research-queue/page/<n>/` | the hub: what the queue is, the no-leaderboard note, the how-to-help strip, start-here entries by place/role/kind, the queue order's first ≤50 cards (K9 §6.1), the D-K11-1 campaign lane, the queue_meta shard table, provenance |
| `/research-queue/sort/<newest\|oldest>/` (+ `…/page/<n>/`) | the K11 §4.2 non-default orders (priority is the hub order) |
| `/research-queue/type/<task_type>/` (+ `…/page/<n>/`, `…/sort/<k>/`) | one-dimension type facet |
| `/research-queue/role/<assignee_class>/` (+ `…/page/<n>/`, `…/sort/<k>/`) | one-dimension role facet with the plain-language role names |
| `/research-queue/place/<slug>/` (+ `…/page/<n>/`, `…/sort/<k>/`, `…/type/<t>/` above the >50-task threshold) | the per-place page on the K4 `place.slug`, covering the place AND its slug-path children; an honest `unplaced` bucket |
| `/research-queue/campaigns/` (+ `…/page/<n>/`) | the `sig.queue-campaign/1` aggregated field-gap rows |

Cards render the v2 contract's real fields — K11 §3 handle + per-type title, closing condition, evidence sought, assignee class + role label, effort, scope, status, trigger + evidence date, the named missing predicate(s), the claim state ("priority, not exclusivity", D-K11-6), the full disposition vocabulary — and never link a `/task/` page P36.62 has not minted. Facet counts reconcile by construction (one facet per dimension per card); the hub names the actual lane counts from `queue_meta`.

Links in (SIG-UI-079, the O4 a-half): every dossier 'What we don't know' section (summary + section variants) links the queue in one action (`data-copy="RQ-07"`), and the home start-here grid gains the queue entry (`data-copy="RQ-03"`). The absence chip's `Help find it ›` already lands on `/research-queue/`; the spec walks chip → hub → place facet → card.

Owns SIG-UI-079, SIG-RQ-004; cites SIG-UI-039/040, SIG-ENG-042; consumes `sig.queue-card/2`, `sig/analytics-queue-meta/2`, `sig.queue-campaign/1`. Six drafted sentences are sha256-pinned `pending` copy-batch rows (batch-01 RQ-02…RQ-07).
